description: Build configuration and script for gcc sanitizers, including functions for configuring, compiling, and installing sanitizer libraries, as well as package dependencies and file lists.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the sanitizer build environment, modifies libtool and Makefile to fix RPATH and sysroot issues.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the sanitizer libraries using make.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled sanitizer libraries and cleans up include directories.
